subject: Aligning success metrics & trial playbook for LuminaHealth POC
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@luminahealth.com>, Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Aligning success metrics & trial playbook for LuminaHealth POC

Hi Claire / Ethan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard from LuminaHealth:
- Primary goal: reduce post-visit charting time for clinicians by surfacing summarized visit notes and suggested billing codes.
- Target users: 10 pilot clinicians in the Cardiology clinic (approx. 120 visits/week).
- Acceptance thresholds: 90% clinician satisfaction in usability survey; autogenerated notes that require <30 seconds of editing on average.

Proposed 4-week POC (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): seed data - 500 de-identified notes, schema review, secure ingest (S3 presigned + KMS keys).
2) Week 1: baseline evaluation & initial model run (30 sample visits).
3) Week 2: rapid iteration on prompts and quantization config; weekly feedback loop with clinicians.
4) Week 3-4: broader validation across 10 clinicians, collect usability survey and edit-time metrics.

Ownership (suggested):
- Redwood PM / trial owner: me (Stephanie) — overall coordinator, weekly status.
- Redwood SE: Ben Carter — integration, data pipeline, runbook.
- LuminaHealth technical lead: Ethan Ross — data access and clinician coordination.
- LuminaHealth clinical champion: Claire Barnes — scheduling and feedback collection.

Immediate asks (can we confirm by Friday?):
- Lumina: designate the 10 clinician participants and confirm approximate schedule windows for Week 3 trials.
- Lumina: provide access method for de-id notes (we prefer S3 presigned links or secure upload to our sandbox).
- Redwood: we will share a short POC checklist and a metrics template (attached).

Attached: lumina-poc-checklist.xlsx (POC steps + runbook), poctrial-metrics-template.docx (survey + edit-time capture), redwood-sla-summary.pdf (security summary).

If that all looks right, I’ll lock the kickoff for Monday, May 17 and schedule a 30-min sync to walk through the checklist.

Thanks —

Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
[Attachment: lumina-poc-checklist.xlsx (13KB)]
[Attachment: poctrial-metrics-template.docx (5KB)]

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning success metrics & trial playbook for LuminaHealth POC

Thanks Stephanie — this is helpful and aligns with our internal view. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Clinician roster: I can confirm 8 clinicians this week and we have 2 more pending credentialing (should be cleared by May 19). I will share the roster by Friday.
- Data access: we can do S3 presigned links; Ethan will coordinate keys and a short transfer window. We will only send de-identified notes.
- Metrics: the survey looks good; can we add a free-text field for clinicians to note any incorrect code suggestions?

Minor ask on timeline: can we shift the kickoff from May 17 to May 18? Our clinical champion has a morning conflict on the 17th. If that works, please resend the invite.

Also: security/compliance check — do you have SOC 2 Type II evidence or an SOC attestation we can reference in the drive link? We’ll need that for our procurement checklist.

Happy to hop on a short call if needed.

Best,
Claire Barnes
Director of Clinical Operations, LuminaHealth

Ben / Marissa — quick internal note after Claire's reply:

1) Kickoff move to May 18 — I’ll update calendar once Claire confirms roster on Friday.
2) Ben: can you draft the minimal ingest runbook for S3 presigned + KMS (include TTLs and validation checks)? Claire asked about de-id; include a checklist of fields we will validate client-side.
3) Marissa: procurement/SOC2 ask — please upload the SOC 2 summary we normally share and the one-page security attestation to the Drive link I created. I’ll pass the link to Claire.

I'll follow up Monday with the updated calendar invite for May 18, 10:00 AM PDT.

Stephanie

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Aligning success metrics & trial playbook for LuminaHealth POC — ingest runbook

Claire —

Nice to meet you on the kickoff. Attached is the minimal ingest runbook we discussed plus a short checklist for de-id validation. Highlights:
- We accept S3 presigned URLs or direct SFTP to the sandbox. Recommend S3 presigned for one-hour TTL.
- Expected schema: visit_id, patient_age_range, visit_timestamp, provider_id, note_text (de-identified). See attached CSV sample.
- We run a quick automated check: PII regex scan (SSN/phone), date normalization, and note length sanity check. If anything fails, we provide a report and reject the batch.

Next technical steps:
1) Ethan to share presigned links for an initial 500 notes by EOD Thu May 20.
2) Redwood to ingest and return a baseline summary by Fri May 21 (edit-time estimate + sample auto-notes).

Attachments: redwood-ingest-runbook.pdf, sample-deid-sample.csv

Thanks — looking forward to results.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-ingest-runbook.pdf (22KB)]

Ben / Stephanie —

Thanks for the kickoff and quick follow-through. Ethan shared the presigned links this morning and we uploaded the first 500 de-identified notes. A couple notes from our side:
- We added the free-text field to the survey template for incorrect code notes — appreciated.
- Procurement: Marissa's SOC 2 summary in the Drive was helpful; procurement will review early next week.

Next steps from Lumina: procurement review (expected Wed May 26), clinician scheduling for Week 3 validation (we'll confirm by May 24).

We look forward to the baseline by Fri May 21 and will compile clinician availability. If anything blocks on your side please flag.

Best,
Claire
Director of Clinical Operations, LuminaHealth
